extract_video_features: extract CLIP video features from image frames using an EgoCLIP model and change point detection segmentation
create_Image_Dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset class that loads and transforms images from a list of file paths
run_extract_video_features: run feature extraction on video frames by passing args and video_num to extract_video_features
review_Image_Dataset_getitem: review the Image_Dataset __getitem__ method that opens an image and applies optional transforms
refactor_extract_video_features: refactor extract_video_features to support configurable batch size and segment detection parameters
